description: Use source and target product references to replace product content while preserving scene consistency.

fields.name: imageUrl
fields.description: Public URL of the base image. The image must be up to 20 MB and between 384 and 8192 pixels in both width and height.

fields.name: targetOriginUrl
fields.description: Public URL of the replacement product image.

fields.name: denoiseStrength
fields.description: Generation denoise strength from 0 to 1. Defaults to 0.5.

fields.name: imageOutputWidth
fields.description: Desired output width in pixels, from 32 to 4096.

fields.name: imageOutputHeight
fields.description: Desired output height in pixels, from 32 to 4096.

fields.name: outputNum
fields.description: Number of images to generate, from 1 to 4. Defaults to 1.
